basic.name: Dislodged
basic.description_template: Tingyun deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of her ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Soothing Melody
skill.description_template: Grants a single ally with Benediction to increase their ATK by {{scaling1}}%, up to {{scaling2}}% of Tingyun's current ATK. When the ally with Benediction attacks, they will deal Lightning Additional DMG equal to {{scaling3}}% of that ally's ATK for 1 time. Benediction lasts for 3 turn(s) and is only effective on the most recent receiver of Tingyun's Skill.

ultimate.name: Amidst the Rejoicing Clouds
ultimate.description_template: Regenerates 50 Energy for a single ally and increases the target's DMG by {{scaling1}}% for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Violet Sparknado
talent.description_template: When an enemy is attacked by Tingyun, the ally with Benediction immediately deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of that ally's ATK to the same enemy.

technique.name: Gentle Breeze
technique.description: Tingyun immediately regenerates 50 Energy upon using her Technique.

2.name: Nourished Joviality
2.description: Tingyun's SPD increases by 20% for 1 turn after using [[Soothing Melody|Skill]].

4.name: Knell Subdual
4.description: DMG dealt by Basic ATK increases by 40%.

6.name: Jubilant Passage
6.description: Tingyun immediately regenerates 5 Energy at the start of her turn.

eidolons.name: Windfall of Lucky Springs
eidolons.description: After using their Ultimate, the ally with Benediction gains a 20% increase in SPD for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Gainfully Gives, Givingly Gains
eidolons.description: The ally with Benediction regenerates 5 Energy after defeating an enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per turn.

eidolons.name: Halcyon Bequest
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Jovial Versatility
eidolons.description: The DMG multiplier provided by Benediction increases by 20%.

eidolons.name: Sauntering Coquette
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Peace Brings Wealth to All
eidolons.description: Ultimate regenerates 10 more Energy for the target ally.
